spans.s:
Gādhivaṃśānucarita
by Śaṅkara Bhaṭṭa, second son of Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa (a. of C. on Vṛttaratnākara, composed in 1565 A. D.), an. father of Nīlakaṇṭha (a. of Vyavahāramayūkha). An account of the scholars of the Gādhi (Viśvāmitra) gotra of Benares, or DakṣiṇaMahārāṣṭra Brahmins, to whose family belonged the famous Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa who reigned supreme in the Paṇḍit world of Kāśī during Toḍar Mal.'s time.
The original home of the scholars of this family was Paiṭhān (Pratiṣṭhāna) in Deccan. They were Ṛgvedins of the Āśval. śākhā. [Page348-b]
Mm. Haraprasad Sastri got a copy made for himself from a. original ms. in Benares. See Ind. Ant. XLI. p. 7; for a. account of the contents of this work, see ibid. p.. 7 ff.
For the geneology of the scholars of this family, see Visvanath Narayan Mandalik's edn. of the Vyavahāramayūkha.
